simulator.note: Boots as a 256 MB C3505 board (chips/c3505.py, run_dump_mini_combo_extra_rca_app_starts.py, run_dump_mini_combo_extra_rca_capture_screen.py): the boot-ROM bootloader runs at 0x9FE00800, sets 0xB8000220 bit 24 to remap physical 0x0F000000..0x0FFFFFFF to the top 16 MB of DDR, writes " ON " to the CH455 panel on GPIO 107 / 110, unpacks seecode ("M3606 SEE", 3.89 MB) to 0xAE000200 and maincode(AV) ("6A000A001552", 10.85 MB) to 0x80000200, and starts both cores (main EBase 0x80002000, SEE EBase 0x8E002001).  The application updates the CH455 panel to " on ", populates userdb(64+64) from defaultdb(PRC) over SPI, and renders its 1280x720 ARGB8888 OSD through the display engine at 0xB8006900 (5 GE commands, 14 unique colours; without the board's anti-clone security IC it displays "SW is not designed for this HW, please change back to offical SW!-----00000000000000 6a000a00").

desc: Amiko Mini Combo Extra RCA (System ID 6A000A00) firmware v1.5.52 EMU (2022-02-17) for the Full HD H.265/HEVC DVB-S2 + DVB-T2/C combo receiver on the ALi M3526C / C3505 SoC with 256 MB DDR3 and 8 MB SPI flash.
Uses the 256 MB DDR remap (0xB8000220 bit 24, SEE at 0xAE000200), a CH455 4-digit LED panel on GPIO 107 (SCL) / 110 (SDA), and the Amiko 0x60xx remote control table ("necfirst" coding).
